Follow the college’s approved rules for your admission year. Hostel timings and outing arrangements may be revised; confirm the current instructions with the warden.

All admitted MBBS students must adhere to the institutional discipline policies established under Notification N.O./SVSMC/CDC 2024/.

1. College Disciplinary Committee (CDC)

Chairperson: Dr. Rohit Dixit, Professor of Pharmacology & Vice-Principal (Academic)

Vice-Chairperson: Dr. P. Suhasini, Professor & HoD of Biochemistry / Girls Hostel Warden

Member-Secretary: Dr. S. Pradeep Reddy, Professor & HOD of Physiology

Coordinator: Dr. Jada Sunil Kumar, Professor of Microbiology / Warden (Boys Hostel)

Faculty Members: Dr. C. Roopa (Microbiology), Dr. Umesh Babu (General Medicine), Dr. Shilpa S. K. (OBG), Dr. Rasheed Fatima (Pathology), Dr C Soren (Pediatrics)

Mandate: Enforces discipline, investigates misconduct, issues penalties (warnings, fines, suspension, expulsion), and holds a minimum of six (6) regular meetings per year.

2. Institutional Code of Conduct & Fines

RULES AND REGULATIONS

The rules & regulations of the college disciplinary committee and the recommended disciplinary action for violating them are hereby established and outlined as follows:

RULE 1: DISCIPLINE IN THE COLLEGE/HOSPITAL

All the existing college rules and rules framed from time to time are to be followed strictly along with the following rules and regulations.

1.1. ID Cards: All the students should wear their ID Cards while they are in the college & hospital campus and in their respective class rooms.

1.2. Dress code - Following a formal dress code in college demonstrates professionalism & respect. All the students should wear the apron during practical labs/dissection hall, clinical postings

Men – Formal trousers & shirt neatly ironed, polished shoes, well-coiffed hair, and a cleanly shaved/trimmed beard.

Women – Kurthi with loose pants or long kurthi with leggings. Short kurthies, Sleeveless dress, Jeans and T shirts are not allowed.

1.3. Skipping class: Students should not skip the lecture classes, practical classes/dissection, Clinical postings without valid reason & permission from respective faculty/in charge. Student should not be found in their hostel room, in parking area, canteen and in other areas of the campus like playing ground, parapet wall, indoor stadium during the college hours.

1.4. Sick policy: A student who is not well or suffering from some health issues, need to consult a doctor in our hospital (Not less than Assistant professor level), if the doctor advices for adequate rest, he/she needs to submit the OP consultation card to the respective warden and then the warden will allow them to take rest in the designated rooms only (sick room). They are not entitled to get the attendance during this rest period.

1.5. Proxy attendance: The students should not give proxy attendance of their peers.

1.6. Cell phones policy: Students are strictly prohibited from bringing mobile phones / tablets into the lecture classes, practical classes/dissection & Clinical postings.

1.7. Examination: During Formative/Internal assessment or University examination including practical examination, all the students should reach the examination hall well before the time, should cooperate with the security personnel & invigilators during frisking, should not involve/indulge in any type of malpractice including and not limited to bringing cell phones, printed materials, electronic gadgets, digital smart watches, exchanging answers with peers etc.

1.8. Maintaining the College property: The college property is to be maintained and protected properly.

1.9. Behaviour with others: All the students should behave professionally in the college / hospital / hostel premises. Causing harm to the political and religious sentiments of others is strictly prohibited. Any form of argument, quarrel, verbal or physical abuse, threats towards peers, students of other batches or courses, security personnel, caretakers, nurses, ward boys, ayammas, mess serving staff, technicians, or any other office or hospital staff will be deemed highly unprofessional. Such behavior will be addressed on a case-by-case basis, and appropriate disciplinary action will be taken based on the recommendations of the committee.

Note: Ragging / gender harassment issues / complaints will be dealt as per the existing anti-ragging / gender harassment laws.

1.10. Complying with Security norms: All the students should comply with the security norms & should cooperate fully with the security personal while discharging his duties like checking ID cards, gate passes, vehicles, hostel rooms and monitoring the movements of the students.

RULE 2: DISCIPLINE IN THE HOSTEL / CAMPUS

All the existing hostel rules and rules framed from time to time are to be followed strictly along with the following rules and regulations.

2.1. Etiquettes in hostel:

1. It is the responsibility of the student to maintain & protect the college property including and not limited to chairs, tables, cupboards, walls etc.

2. Resources like food, water & electricity should be used judiciously. Electronic & electric appliances including and not limited to refrigerators, TVs, projectors, speakers, washing machines, mixer grinders, etc will not be allowed inside the hostel room.

3. Hostel students are not allowed to carry food to their rooms.

4. Day scholars / other people like friends are not allowed to enter the hostel rooms.

5. Parents and guardians are allowed to visit the hostel rooms preferably on weekends from 04:00 to 07:00 PM with prior permission from respective wardens.

6. Students who are staying in hostel are not allowed to hold / use two wheelers/four wheelers (either own or others)

7. Students are not allowed to exchange their rooms with others without prior permission from their respective wardens.

2.2. Consumption of outside food: While utmost care & hygiene is being taken to prepare the food in the college mess, it is advised to all the students to minimize / avoid consuming the outside food. Collection of the food which is ordered by food delivery apps is limited to 9:00 PM in the night. Exploiting / forcing the juniors to pay for the ordered food or to buy food / beverages from outside will be considered as ragging and suitable action will be initiated as per anti-ragging laws.

2.3. Outing policy (Home visits / Local outings):

1. All undergraduate students and interns must present a request email from their parents to the respective wardens (svsmedicalcollegegirlshostel@gmail.com, svsmcboyshostel@gmail.com) to obtain approval. They should also get a pass from the designated authority between 3:00 PM and 4:00 PM for outings or visits to their hometown. This pass must be shown to the security personnel when leaving the college campus.

2. All undergraduate students are not allowed to leave the campus during working hours. In case of an emergency or if classes are cancelled, students must obtain permission from the Head of the Department or a faculty member, and have it countersigned by the wardens, to obtain gate pass & leave the campus.

3. All undergraduate students and interns must record their entry and exit times, along with other required details, in the "Student Movement Register" maintained by the security personnel while leaving the campus.

4. All the UG students/ Interns are instructed to produce their ID cards (at least soft copy in the mobile) to the security personnel for verification.

5. The UG students are supposed to return to the hostels by 08:00PM. (Interns to return by 09:00PM)

6. The UG students/ Interns are instructed not to argue with the security personnel in any condition, any issues regarding the same can be brought to the notice of respective wardens.

2.4. Illegal activities in the hostel/campus: Smoking, Alcohol consumption and Narcotics abuse are strictly prohibited in the hostel & college campus. All these complaints will be dealt as per the existing Telangana Anti-Narcotics Bureau rules.

Note:

1. A Student is responsible for all the illegal activities (If any) happening in his room, he/she cannot claim excuse because he was not available in his room at the time of the event.

2. If a student is found in intoxicated state, he/she will be shifted to hospital for confirming the abuse and further course of action will be as per the decision of the committee and management.

3. Betting & Gambling is strictly prohibited in the hostel premises

RULE 3: DISCIPLINE IN THE LIBRARY

All the existing library rules and rules framed from time to time are to be followed strictly along with the following rules and regulations. Maintaining the strict discipline and professionalism in the library premises is highly appreciated.

3.1. All the students who enter the library should sign in the visitors register without fail.

3.2. Food items including and not limited to snacks, biscuits, beverages etc is prohibited in the library.

3.3. All the students should carry only books and other stationaries inside the library, any other belongings

3.4. should be kept outside the premises.

3.5. All the students should keep silence and should not disturb others in the library.

3.6. Mobile phones should be kept in silent mode when they are in the library.

3.7. All the existing library rules and the rules framed from time to time should be followed regularly.

RULE 4: DISCIPLINE IN THE MESS / CANTEEN

4.1 All the students are instructed to adhere to the mess timings. (Note: Students are also advised to come to mess well before the closing time to avail all the items in the menu.)

4.2. First MBBS students are supposed to sit their allotted areas while having food.

4.3. Interactions with the food serving staff and other mess personnel should be conducted in a respectful and professional manner.

4.4. Students are instructed not to waste food while in the mess. Failure to comply may result in disciplinary action.

4.5 The mess facilities are exclusively for hostel students. Day scholars are not permitted to consume the mess food.

4.6 Hostel residents are prohibited from taking mess food to their rooms. Violation of this rule, evidenced by findings such as plates in the rooms, will result in disciplinary action. (Note: In case a student is unwell or unable to go to the mess for any reason, they must obtain prior permission from their respective wardens.)

4.7 Should students wish to make suggestions or register complaints regarding any food-related issues in the mess, they are required to submit them in writing to the mess in-charge. Additionally, a copy of the written communication must be provided to their respective hostel wardens.

Disciplinary action: Students who violate the above rules will be dealt with on a case-by-case basis, in accordance with the rules and regulations of the College, the University, the NMC, and other relevant regulatory bodies. Appropriate disciplinary action will be initiated based on the recommendations of the Committee. Details of the disciplinary action taken will be communicated to the concerned students and their parents.
